blocks.text: The Agent Telemetry page gives insight into your organization's agent data. It allows you to monitor and analyze the agent data for all installed agents in your organization.
The Agent Telemetry page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View a summary of agent data in your organization.
View, monitor, and analyze agent data from a single workload.
Take appropriate actions based on the data displayed on the page about the agents.
Discover insights about any agent errors.

blocks.text: On the Agent Telemetry page (Data Explorer > Microsegmentation > Agent Telemetry), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the time range up to the last 14 days.
Refresh the Agent Telemetry page to reflect the most current information.

Filter the information. Click the + icon to view additional filters. After configuring your preferred filters, click the button to apply the filters (e.g., Apply 1 filter, Apply 2 filters) and view the results.
View a list of all agent data for your organization. For each agent, you can see:
Timestamp: The date and time of the agent's last usage.
Agent CPU Util (%): The percentage of CPU in megabytes that the agent used.
Agent Memory Util (MB) The total memory in megabytes that the agent used.
Agent ID: The agent ID number.
Expand an individual agent to view its complete information.
